_comment: D239 (from Ewan's 'what other games do well', #270 keep 2, Necesse; #284). Each land of the eighteen (data/biomes.json) gets a page in the journal the first time the party sets foot in it: a few things to do there, and one rare trinket for doing them all. A page is written once and kept (the world's `lands`), so what it asks never changes under the player. `entries` in order; `count` is how many; a `place` entry is only on a land with a place in it that is not a gate, a `gate` entry only on a land with a gate in it; `walk` asks for no more stretches than the land has. `trinkets`: one a land, carried by the company (not by one fighter), never sold, dropped or lost while the world lasts. Effects stack across trinkets: `stride` (a share added to walking speed on the land), `wade` (shallow pools on the land can be walked through), `hush` (cells taken off how far a band on the land sees), `attack` and `defense` (added to every fighter of the party), `health` (a share added to every fighter's health in a fight), `proof` (the land's hazards it keeps off everyone: cold, heat, ooze). lines: opened ({land}), ticked ({entry}, {land}, {done}, {of}), finished ({land}, {trinket}, {what}), annal ({land}, {trinket}).

entries.text: Find something somebody left out in {land}
Stand in one of its places

lines.opened: A new page in the journal: {land}. There are things here worth doing.
lines.finished: Every line on the {land} page is crossed off. Something has turned up for it: the {trinket}. {what}
lines.annal: The company finished its page of {land}, and came away with the {trinket}.

grassland.name: Wayfarer's Boots
grassland.text: Soft leather, worn to the shape of somebody who walked a very long way.

forest.name: Moss Cloak
forest.text: Green on green. Bands look straight past it.

snow.name: Bearfur Mittens
snow.text: Too big for anyone's hands, and warm as a hearth.

dune.name: Sandstrider Sandals
dune.text: Wide soles of woven grass that skim the sand.

badlands.name: Rattlesnake Fang
badlands.text: Hung on a thong. Whoever wears it strikes first and asks after.

savanna.name: Lion's Mane Torc
savanna.text: A ring of beaten gold. It still smells of dry grass and lion.

ash.name: Cinderglass Charm
ash.text: Black glass from a burnt gate, cool however hot the ground.

blight.name: Rowan Ward
blight.text: Red berries strung on rowan twigs. The blight will not touch it.

slime.name: Saltglass Boots
slime.text: Glazed with salt to the knee. The ooze slides off.

bog.name: Heron Stilts
bog.text: Long legs of ash wood. The shallows are only ground with water on.

swamp.name: Leech-Bone Needle
swamp.text: Stitches a wound shut before it knows it was made.

crystal.name: Prism Shard
crystal.text: Light bends round it, and so do blows.

fungal.name: Glowcap Lantern
fungal.text: A soft light that nothing else seems able to see.

blossom.name: Petal Locket
blossom.text: Pressed petals that never brown. It is hard to give up with it on.

barrow.name: Barrow King's Ring
barrow.text: Old gold from a howe. Its first owner fought well, and still wants to.

jungle.name: Jaguar Tooth
jungle.text: Yellowed and sharp. It wants to be used.

taiga.name: Wolfskin Wrap
taiga.text: The whole pelt, head and all, and the cold cannot get past it.

mist.name: Mist Lantern
mist.text: It gives no light at all, and in the mist that is the point.
